DentalWize Kraaifontein is a dental practice in Brighton Square Shopping Centre on Brighton Road, part of the DentalWize group with branches across the Cape. The practice describes its care as comprehensive and affordable for the whole family.

Regular hours run Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00, with Saturday appointments available on two Saturdays a month. The practice also runs an after-hours emergency service by WhatsApp, with call-out fees that apply on top of any treatment performed.

The practice suits families in Kraaifontein who want routine dental care with the option of an emergency call-out on weekends and public holidays.

Haasendal Dental is a family dental practice in the Haasendal Gables Shopping Centre in Kuils River, describing itself as a gentle, affordable dentist for the whole family. The practice offers general and cosmetic dentistry in a modern, welcoming setting.

Treatments include dental cleanings and check-ups, fillings, crowns, bridges and veneers, implants and dentures, root canals and teeth whitening. The practice also offers Invisalign clear aligners for discreet orthodontic treatment, and its website is written in both English and Afrikaans.

The practice suits families in Kuils River, Brackenfell and Protea Heights who want routine dental care or a full smile makeover from one local team.

items.description:
PostNet Kuilsriver is a branch of the national PostNet network, offering courier, copy and print, and postal services from Kerkplein Centre on Van Riebeeck Road in Kuils River. As part of the PostNet group, the branch handles domestic parcel sending through options such as PostNet2PostNet and PostNet2Door, alongside international courier services including DHL Express, so customers can send documents and parcels locally or abroad from one counter.

Beyond courier work, the branch also offers digital services such as internet access, email facilities and fax-to-email, making it a practical stop for everyday printing, copying and document errands. The store trades Monday to Friday from eight in the morning until five in the afternoon, and on Saturday mornings until one, closing on Sundays and public holidays. It suits individuals and small businesses in Kuils River who need reliable courier, printing, stationery or digital services close to home.

items.description:
Sorbet Salon Meadowridge is a beauty salon offering facial and skincare treatments, hair removal, makeup application and massage from its branch in the Park 'n Shop centre. Its facial menu includes an acne facial, a dermaplaning facial, facial extractions, a men's facial and microdermabrasion, while hair removal is offered through eyebrow threading, giving clients a range of targeted treatments rather than a single generic facial.

The salon operates under the long-established Sorbet beauty franchise, which brings a standardised range of treatments and trained therapists to local shopping centres across South Africa. This franchise backing means clients can expect consistent treatment standards and booking processes wherever they visit a Sorbet branch.

Sorbet Salon Meadowridge trades from Shop 13, Park 'n Shop, Firgrove Way in Meadowridge, open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and weekends from 09:00 to 17:00, and suits clients wanting facial, hair removal, makeup or massage treatments close to home in the southern suburbs.

Spec-Savers Brackenfell is an optometry practice offering eye examinations, spectacles and contact lenses from inside Brackenfell Shopping Centre. The practice has traded from this location since opening in November 2006, giving it close to two decades of continuous service in the area.

Its team of six includes qualified optometry staff who carry out eye tests and help patients choose and fit spectacles and contact lenses. The practice also keeps backup power on site, allowing eye examinations and dispensing to continue during load-shedding and other outages.

Spec-Savers Brackenfell trades from Shop 19-20 in Brackenfell Shopping Centre, on the corner of Old Paarl Road and Jeanette Street in Brackenfell, and suits patients wanting an established optometry practice with dependable eye-care services close to home.

items.description:
The Reef is a seafood restaurant on Main Road in Kalk Bay, opened in December 2025 right on the tourist strip along the False Bay coastline. A Time Out Cape Town review rated the restaurant four out of five stars, describing ocean views, succulent seafood and a laid-back beach vibe.

The restaurant seats up to 300 diners, a scale the reviewer called a bold move for a new opening so close to Cape Town's busy summer season. The review notes that The Reef survived and thrived through its first three months of trading over summer.

The restaurant is at 35 Main Road in Kalk Bay, on one of the most scenic stretches of coastline near the railway line from Muizenberg, and suits a seafood meal with sea views in a relaxed, beachy setting.

Village Sushi is a restaurant in Noordhoek Farm Village serving ocean-fresh sushi and Asian cuisine, including Thai curries, dim sum, noodle dishes and oysters. The restaurant offers sit-down dining as well as takeaway and delivery, giving diners flexibility in how they enjoy its menu.

Trading from the Farm Village, the restaurant forms part of this well-known Noordhoek lifestyle and shopping destination, alongside its mix of farm stalls, shops and other eateries. It is open daily from midday to 9pm, giving diners a wide window for a late lunch, dinner or early evening meal.

Village Sushi serves restaurant customers, takeaway customers and delivery customers from its location at Noordhoek Farm Village on Village Lane in Noordhoek, and suits anyone wanting a varied Asian-style menu in a relaxed village setting outside central Cape Town.

items.description:
Amare is a Mediterranean restaurant on Victoria Road in Bantry Bay, describing its food as South Coast Mediterranean. The restaurant serves breakfast through dinner with sea-facing dining, and its name comes from the Latin word for love.

A winter special menu reviewed by Inside Guide included starters of crumbed feta with honey, cabernet balsamic and oregano, and kingklip ajillo with garlic, chilli and capers. Mains on the special included spaghetti all'Assassina, pappardelle ragu with fior di latte, and chicken limone with apple and fennel salad, while desserts included lemon posset and bread pudding with sabayon cream.

The restaurant takes bookings through DinePlan and is open daily from midday to 11pm. It suits a relaxed Mediterranean-style meal with a sea view in Bantry Bay.

Barksole Riverlands Mall is a specialist repair outlet trading near the main entrance of Riverlands Mall in Observatory. As part of the Barksole chain, it offers shoe and luggage repairs, key cutting, engraving, number plate replacement, car remote battery replacement and custom-made rubber stamps.

This mix of services covers everyday practical needs that are otherwise hard to find under one roof, from mending a worn pair of shoes or a damaged suitcase to cutting a replacement key, engraving an item or getting a car remote battery replaced. The branch is one of several Barksole outlets trading across Cape Town shopping centres.

Barksole Riverlands Mall trades from Shop G34 near the mall entrance at Riverlands Mall, 51 Gogosoa Street in Observatory, open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 19:00 and weekends from 09:00 to 17:00, and suits customers needing footwear or luggage repairs, key and engraving work, or other specialist repair services in one visit.

items.description:
BUC Fitness Club is a boutique wellness and fitness gym on the third floor of The Point in Sea Point, with views over the Atlantic Ocean and Lion's Head. The club describes itself as the most exclusive fitness facility on Cape Town's Atlantic Seaboard.

Its team includes personal trainers, biokineticists, sports scientists and physiotherapists, and training programmes cover weight loss, muscle building, sport-specific training and wellness. The club also houses the first SWEAT1000 studio in South Africa, alongside luxurious post-workout facilities.

Membership options include day, week, model and student packages with no requirement to commit to a long-term contract, and new members receive a personal training session and discounts at the PUMA Concept Store. The club suits anyone looking for a premium training experience on the Atlantic Seaboard.

Checkers Liquor Store Sea Point is a liquor retail outlet selling alcoholic beverages, including beer, wine and spirits, trading from The Point shopping centre. The centre's own merchant listing identifies it as a dedicated Checkers Liquor outlet, distinct from the Checkers supermarket chain's grocery stores.

The store keeps long trading hours, open daily from 07:00 to 20:30, including on public holidays, giving shoppers an extended window to pick up liquor for home use or social occasions while visiting the centre for other shopping.

Checkers Liquor Store trades from Ground Floor Shop 01 at The Point, 76 Regent Road in Sea Point, and suits adult shoppers looking to buy beer, wine or spirits as part of a visit to the centre.

Lee's Chinese is a Chinese restaurant in Sherwood Shopping Centre in Bergvliet, trading since 2006. The restaurant serves Chinese food alongside fresh sushi and takeaway, with soups, spring rolls and speciality dishes such as Drunken Pork, Spicy Beef and Wayne's Wacky Salad.

Its buffet is priced at R79 a head, with R40 for children under 12, and the restaurant says it offers the best Chinese food in the Southern Suburbs. The restaurant can seat 80 people, making it a choice for functions and birthday parties, and booking is essential.

Special dishes on the menu include Hong Kong Chicken alongside the buffet standards. The restaurant is in Sherwood Shopping Centre on the corner of Children's Way and Dreyersdal Road in Bergvliet, and suits a sit-down meal, a buffet outing or a takeaway order for the family.
